scene_features.selection_logic: This three-panel progression follows a rising narrative tension. Panel 1 establishes a quiet but ominous baseline context by showing storm clouds and rain hitting a window, representing the causal warning ('want het gaat hard regenen'). Panel 2 introduces a heavier physical action of preparation, showing a close-up of a hand grabbing the umbrella ('Neem een paraplu mee'). Panel 3 is the dominant payoff, uniting the prepared action and the environmental condition as the character steps outside with the umbrella under the active rain. This setup_detail_payoff structure fully captures the sentence's instructions without unnecessary expansion.
